summary: Fail. The story, facts, sync and ending are good, but both round-1 fixes only half landed. The night-timeline shot (67–70 s) still runs off the right edge (the red cut block reaches about x=1060, past the 930 px safe line and under the platform buttons). The rod shot (32–36 s) now shows a toy-like stick-legged mouse with no fur or tail, and the 「回る棒」 leader line still points into the caption instead of at the rod.
